zh.morning: 做早饭，煎蛋和吐司，慢慢吃完再收拾
zh.workWithOccupation: 开始{occupation}的活儿，先把手头的理清楚
zh.work: 在桌前做自己的事，先把手头的理清楚
zh.afternoon: 在窗边坐一会儿，画点东西
zh.dinner: 做晚饭，吃完窝在沙发上歇一会儿
zh.eveningWithCity: 下楼走一圈，{city}的晚上有点凉
zh.evening: 下楼走一圈，晚上风有点凉

en: Made breakfast and ate it slowly
Started work at the desk, sorted out what's at hand first
Left some time for a hobby, no rushing
Made dinner, then curled up on the sofa for a while
Went for a walk downstairs; the night wind is a little chilly
